glosses: audacious, reckless (impudent, stupid, inappropriate through lacking consideration); generally of speech or social behaviour, not dangerous acts

examples.text: Es war schon dummdreist, den Richter in der Pause zu fragen, was ein Freispruch kosten würde.
examples.translation: It was audacious to ask the judge during the break how much it would cost to be acquitted.
examples.english: It was audacious to ask the judge during the break how much it would cost to be acquitted.
